content:
In addition to the Best Buy 60th anniversary sale, this week's AirPods Pro 3 25% off, AirPods Max 2 all five colors $120 off, and AirTag 2 historical low price deals are still ongoing, but today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also has some new deals worth noting. If you're quick, the official Apple Refurbished Store has just restocked, with the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro down to $1,099 in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue, and we've also spotted multiple brand new M5 Pro MacBook Pro models with $400 off. The Apple Watch Series 11 $100 off deal is also back, starting at just a little over $250, and we also have deals on Twelve South accessories — including their Find My charger and the Curve Nano MagSafe stand at new lows on Amazon. All deals are listed below.

AirPods deals lowered again, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more deals

After a whole summer of solid deals on Apple's latest AirPods lineup, almost every model has dropped even further in price. The highly sought-after AirPods Pro 3 is now 25% off at one of its lowest prices ever, while the ANC-equipped AirPods 4 have also dropped to their lowest in months, and the AirPods Max 2 dropped another $120 off this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)

AirTag 2 back at historical low price again, starting from $22 each (4-pack and single pack)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (original price $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 "Excellent" open-box $20 (original new price $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (original price $99)

Best Buy launches one-day anniversary LG deals: TVs from $330, 2026 OLED models $600 off, more deals

Restock alert: The most affordable M5 MacBook Air is back at $1,099 via Apple Refurbished, act fast (new unit price reduced by $200)

Update 8/20: This deal is now restocked at $1,099, in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This deal will very likely end soon — that's how it always is — but the official Apple Refurbished Store has just restocked the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro, down to $1,099 with free shipping, in Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This configuration sells out fast every time Apple restocks, so if you're interested, don't miss out — after all, this is the cheapest price for the M5 MacBook Air.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,099 with free shipping. As mentioned above, as of writing, Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue are available.

This machine originally retails for $1,299, and is now $200 cheaper than the new unit price.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (original new price $1,299)
  • Midnight Black, Starlight, and Sky Blue

Just a reminder, all products from the official Apple Refurbished Store include the following coverage:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare
  • Sold only after Apple's rigorous refurbishment process

As a comparison, the brand new unit of the same model on Amazon is priced very close to the $1,299 MSRP, with the Silver model down to $1,240.

Amazon still offers $400 off on some configurations of the M5 Pro MacBook Pro

As part of its 60th anniversary sale, Best Buy held a special one-day Apple promotion yesterday. The highlight was $400 off two configurations of the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, but if you missed it, Amazon still has both deals today.

Amazon is still selling both of these 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro models at $400 below MSRP — one with base CPU/GPU specs, the other upgraded to an 18-core CPU and 12-core configuration.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (original price $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (original price $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we recommended yesterday, but at the time it looked like they were only going to last a day — Best Buy did say so, and there was no way to know if Amazon would follow suit. Overall, Amazon could end these deals at any time, but as of writing they're still valid, and we wanted to make sure you're aware.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today

B&H is currently selling the Apple 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB RAM and 1TB storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This $3,099 configuration is $400 cheaper than buying directly from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary $100 off, Best Buy open-box from $254

Although yesterday's 24-hour limited 60th anniversary Apple promotion has ended, there are still plenty of great deals. In addition to the AirPods Pro 3 25% off, AirPods Max 2 $120 off, and the historical low price return for Apple's latest AirTag 2, we've also spotted that all the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models on Amazon and Best Buy are $100 off — you can even find "Excellent" open-box models as low as $254.

Amazon is once again selling all base 46mm Series 11 models for $329 with free shipping. That's $100 off the $429 MSRP, and all four case colors are available at this discounted price.

However, their stock of the smaller and cheaper 42mm version is now almost completely sold out. This is where Best Buy comes in.

They're in the middle of a week-long 60th anniversary sale, with all 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models in stock and selling for $100 off MSRP.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

Although the price difference isn't huge, I also want to mention the "Excellent" open-box deal on the Jet Black 42mm model — you can get one for $253.99 with free shipping, which is $145 cheaper than the new MSRP. Compared to buying a new unit right now it's only $45 less, but $45 is not a small amount, and it's the lowest price we can find at a reputable retailer.

Amazon's top-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models $220 off today (rivaling Prime Day deals)

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (original new price $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (original new price $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (original new price $1,299)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store feature, you can get a fully functional iPhone 16 starting from $699 with a one-year Apple warranty; while the 1TB 16 Pro Max goes for $1,269 — that's $330 cheaper than a comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than the 17 series)

The Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the best-looking MagSafe stands I've ever seen, grab one for $27 (original price $35)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Twelve South's versatile woven PowerCord USB-C charger now down to $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for just $180? Rare deal drops WD Elements portable hard drive to lowest price since storage price hikes (today only)
  • Woot's latest deals: Keychron mechanical keyboards from $20, up to 64% off
  • This 14-in-1 Anker Prime docking station is $100 off, a new low price
  • This Anker 8-outlet power strip with USB and surge protection is $22 today
  • Upgrade your home theater with the Govee TV Backlight 3 Lite kit for responsive lighting effects, from $110, more models from $60
  • Petcube Cam 360 offers 360-degree pet monitoring and two-way talk for $35
  • Govee's latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite with Matter, from $85, or other models up to 47% off, from $80
  • Anker Nano 100W three-port charger with 5-foot cable, $36 today

Amazon now has all five colors of AirPods Max 2 at $120 off (one of the best prices ever)

This week's 60th anniversary sale brings one of the best prices ever for Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, and Amazon now has all five colors at $120 off.

Amazon is now selling Apple's AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Priced the same as the previous generation at $549, that's $120 saved, and it's the lowest new unit price we can currently find at a reputable retailer.

Best Buy does have a Midnight Black set in "Excellent" open-box condition for $403.99 with free shipping, which is cheaper, but may not be cheap enough to pass up on a new unit.

Apple launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, not just a new color with a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, their over-ear model won't be updated in next month's new product launch, so this week we can grab this product — which may be Apple's latest and greatest over-ear headphones for some time — at $120 off.

There has only been one promotion that sold for less than this — this summer's Prime Day, when the price was another $30 lower than today's deal price — and inventory during that 4-day promotion was quite limited and unstable.

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger still at its $26 low, but this bundle adds a USB-C cable for just $4 more

As part of its ongoing 60th anniversary sale, Best Buy is selling the white Anker 45W Nano smart display charger for $29.99 with free shipping, and includes a Nano USB-C cable. That's only about $4 more than the charger's current discounted price of $25.99 with free shipping, which is still available on both Amazon and Best Buy. Considering the included Nano USB-C cable normally sells for around $18, you're essentially paying just $4 to add the cable — a very worthwhile choice. See below for more details.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN smart display charger $25.99 (original price $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

Anker's 45W Nano charger features a built-in smart display that identifies supported devices (such as iPhone and iPad Pro models) and automatically adjusts power delivery. The screen also displays real-time charging info and animations, so you can see the charging status the moment you plug in your device. It features a top-mounted USB-C port that delivers up to 45W output, plus foldable prongs that fold 180 degrees, making it easy to carry whether for daily use or travel. Anker offers four colors, including an orange that pairs well with Apple's Cosmic Orange devices. This special deal adds Anker's Nano USB-C cable for just $4 more. This braided cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it a solid choice overall — and if you're looking for a new reliable cable to charge your phone, it's an absolute bargain.

Other Anker deals worth noting

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (original price $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging stand with display $135 (original price $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch controls $116 (original price $150)
